event_name: Date 25 October 2020 Time 14:35 2020 PORTUGUESE GRAND PRIX 22 to 25 October The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5.1.d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and positioning data evidence. While Kvyat did pass blue flags in multiple sectors the Stewards noted that Bottas had just exited the pits on hard tyres and had been passed by several cars including Kvyat. The Stewards reviewed the on-boards from following cars and noted that it was several sectors before Bottas had full grip, at which point Kvyat did let him by. Therefore, the stewards take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 26 Alleged Ignoring Blue Flags
